comment: Curated registry of unofficial cores installable on the MiSTer via the custom Downloader database (docs/unofficial/db.json.zip). THIS FILE IS THE APPROVAL GATE: build_unofficial_db.py only reads what is merged here. The weekly scan proposes additions by PR; review each entry, delete what you do not want installed, and merge. Entry fields: repo (owner/name), arcade (true = .mra territory, installs under _Unofficial Cores/_Arcade), notes (free text), added (date).
